## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Leadership is Narrow (4/5 Top performers are Technology) and mixed sector internals (Tech leaders ABOVE TREND vs Financials/Health showing exhaustion), which confirms a neutral, non-committal market tone.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads on a 1W basis with XOM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -11.95%) in RECOVERY and CVX (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -10.79%) in RECOVERY; Utilities showing strength with CEG (1W: +10.09% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples has pockets of strength with PM (1W: +8.25% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication (1W: -4.19%) is weakest with CHTR (1W: -28.45% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary (1W: -2.67%) shows pressure—BKNG (1W: -9.16% | 1M: +6.70%) in CORRECTION. Industrials (1W: -1.75%) has notable losers like LMT (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -16.81%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +13.66% | 1M: +39.23%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +60.01%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +10.09% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology), signaling concentrated strength in semis/tech.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: DHR (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.40% | 1M: +19.25%) CORRECTION, ACN (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -9.16% | 1M: +6.70%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select Tech/software and industrial-related names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Big 1W movers: INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +13.66% | 1M: +39.23%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +60.01%) ABOVE TREND; note Major Divergence across large caps (multiple large names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend break and avoid overreading a single-week surge.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but leadership-heavy: AAPL (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND while ORCL (1W: -8.40% | 1M: +19.25%) is in CORRECTION and NOW (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND — Tech internals are bifurcated despite headline strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Internal rotation: JPM (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +10.68%) in CORRECTION, V (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +4.66%) in CORRECTION, MA (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +5.01%) in CORRECTION — 1M strength amid 1W softness points to profit-taking rather than broad sell-off.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Cautious: UNH (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +41.60%) ABOVE TREND is a standout, but DHR (1W: -8.00% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -3.21% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND show dispersion; sector tone is mixed and reactionary to news.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor high-conviction exposure to leading semiconductors and selected industrial earners (INTC, AMD, NVDA, UNP) while reducing exposure to names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (ORCL, NOW, LMT). Maintain position discipline given narrow leadership and the major divergence across big caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +60.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +41.60%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -28.45% | 1M: -21.00%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.40% | 1M: +19.25%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W +3.40%) and Utilities (1W +3.27%) for defensive/cash-flow strength; Real Estate (1W +0.35%) for selected names. BEARISH: Communication (1W -4.19%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W -2.67%) where news and earnings sensitivity may amplify moves.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND — watch prior highs as continuation trigger; INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for profit-taking after the gap; ORCL (1W: -8.40% | 1M: +19.25%) CORRECTION — watch 1W follow-through for trend confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
NUE (+55): Nucor Q1 beat; NUE (1W: +8.19% | 1M: +38.26%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. VTR (+55): Ventas beat; VTR (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +7.60%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned. BA (+55): New orders announced; BA (1W: +5.27% | 1M: +21.10%) ABOVE TREND — confirming accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-50): EU probe headlines; META (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +27.70%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverges from price (distribution risk). NOW (-50): negative reaction to results; NOW (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. BKNG (-55): outlook cut; BKNG (1W: -9.16% | 1M: +6.70%) CORRECTION — news aligns with short-term pullback.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, growth/momentum-leaning given concentrated Tech leadership. INTC (1W: +27.56% | 1M: +95.97%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +27.25%) ABOVE TREND show clear relative strength. Major divergence among large caps (ORCL CORRECTION, NOW BELOW TREND) and narrow leadership warrant monitoring of news flow (META -50) before adding new core exposure.
